name: Is it worth paying for walls, ceilings, trim, and doors instead of just walls?

mainEntity.name: Is it worth paying for walls, ceilings, trim, and doors instead of just walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main value question is whether you need walls only or a more complete refresh with ceilings, trim, and doors. A broader package costs more upfront, but it usually creates a more uniform finish and can be the better value if your trim or ceilings are visibly worn.
acceptedAnswer.description: If trim and ceilings are worn, the fuller package usually looks cleaner and more finished. Walls-only is cheaper, but it may leave older surfaces looking mismatched.
